nodes_add.name: Rajaratna Manikrao
nodes_add.note: Founder of the Jummadada Vyayam Mandir, Baroda; trained Kuvalayananda in physical culture 1907-1910.

nodes_add.name: Paramahamsa Madhavdas
nodes_add.note: Yogi settled at Malsar near Baroda; Kuvalayananda's teacher from 1918/1919. Dates 1798-1921 given by Kaivalyadhama are unsourced, so omitted.

nodes_add.name: Seer Paranjyothi
nodes_add.note: Said to have initiated Vethathiri into kundalini yoga; known only from the movement's account.

glossary.def: A set of breathing and meditation techniques taught in the line of Lahiri Mahasaya, which the lineage says he received from Babaji in 1861.
One of the four ages of the Hindu cycle of time: Satya, Treta, Dvapara and Kali. Tradition gives Kali Yuga 432,000 years; Sri Yukteswar proposed a 24,000-year cycle.
A yoga posture. In modern classes, one of the many named poses, such as the triangle or the headstand.
The branch of yoga that works through postures, breath control and cleansing practices, described in medieval texts such as the Hatha Yoga Pradipika.
A hatha yoga cleansing practice in which the abdominal muscles are isolated and rolled. Kuvalayananda's first published experiment was an X-ray study of it.
A traditional south Indian rejuvenation practice of breathing, diet and exercise, said to slow the body's decline. Vethathiri taught his own version.
In Tamil tradition, an adept credited with yoga techniques and with a system of medicine that also bears the name Siddha.

issues: yukteswar.mdx: year of formal ordination conflicts (Ananda says 1906; Wikipedia says a Bodh Gaya mahant, undated; Babaji conferred the title in 1894 per Autobiography). Presented as a conflict.

yukteswar.mdx: I could not open Autobiography ch. 43 (hinduwebsite fetch failed), so the Bombay appearance is attributed only through the Kriya Yoga Institute page; the June 1936 date is not given. The 1914 swami initiation date and 'about fifty-five' come from fetched summaries of chs. 24 and 10, not the full text.

yukteswar.mdx: Wikipedia says Holy Science was written in 1894; I found no source for the first printing date. The Sanskrit-title gloss 'vision of liberation' is the writer's own translation. Satyananda's biography was listed, not read.

yukteswar.mdx: the claim that the standard account of precession does not use a companion star rests on one explanatory page (explainingscience.org) plus Wikipedia's note on the Binary Research Institute; a stronger astronomical source would help. The Holy Science dates Kali's low point c. 500 (Autobiography) vs c. 550 (Wikipedia); text says 'around the year 500'.
yukteswar.mdx: Yukteswar's wife's death 1895 and 1884 meeting date come from Ananda/Wikipedia only (movement sources).

kuvalayananda.mdx: birthplace unresolved (Dabhoi per Wikipedia and Kaivalyadhama legacy page; 'a village in Gujarat' per Bodhe; 'Dumad' in the assignment notes could not be verified). Place marked verified:false.

kuvalayananda.mdx: founding of Kaivalyadhama given as 1924 Lonavla (all sources) but 1917 Amalner on two kdham pages; Bodhe's Vijayadashami 1924 (he says 7 October) not checked against a calendar so day omitted. Madhavdas meeting 1919 vs end of 1918. Madhavdas dates 1798-1921 are unsourced (Wikipedia: citation needed).

kuvalayananda.mdx: Gandhi correspondence rests only on Bodhe, a Kaivalyadhama insider. Stamp date: ETV Bharat preview says release scheduled 30 Aug 2019; Wikipedia says released in 2019. Text says 2019 only. Padma awards for him not found.

iyengar.mdx: Krishnamacharya move at 14 (RIMYI) vs 1934 (Wikipedia, age ~15); typhoid (Wikipedia) vs typhus (RIMYI); death-report date 20/21 Aug; Light on Yoga translations 17 vs 23 languages (omitted). Iyengar's 'first used props' history is not independently confirmed; text attributes to Wikipedia citing Mehta et al. 1990.

iyengar.mdx: Bellur coordinates not verified (rate limit), so no Bellur place entry. Manouso Manos 2019 decertification (IYNAUS) deliberately left out as not about Iyengar; author may want it under Descendants. No online recording of Iyengar's voice found with a direct URL; film Samadhi (1977) is sold by RIMYI with no link. Profile has no media section.

vethathiri.mdx: sources are thin and mostly movement or proponent-supplied (stamp catalogue, Wikipedia with weak citations). Guru Paranjyothi, A. Balakrishna, age-12 meeting, kundalini initiation are unverified beyond Wikipedia. Book count 70 vs 75; age at death 95 (stamp page) vs 94 (arithmetic); 1,500 centres and UN ECOSOC status are organisation claims. UN invitation 9 Jan 1975 only from the proponent-supplied stamp page. 14 Vethathiriam points not found, so not listed. Tamil title script (manavalakalai) spelling unverified. Aliyar and Thiruvanmiyur coordinates unverified.
All four: the weekly usage limit interrupted research once; Aliyar village, Belluru/Bellur and several Wikipedia pages could not be fetched after that point.

yukteswar: Born 10 May 1855 Serampore; parents Kshetranath and Kadambini; daughter; Lahiri 1884; Holy Science 1894; Puri ashram 1903; died 9 March 1936 Puri -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swami_Sri_Yukteswar_Giri (via fetch summary); https://en.bharatpedia.org/wiki/Swami_Sri_Yukteswar_Giri
Birth 10 May 1855; Puri Karar Ashram 22 March 1903; death 9 March 1936; Lahiri called him Priya; Hariharananda as disciple; Babaji accounts -> https://kriya.org/guru/swami-shriyukteshwar-giri/en

Wife died 1895; formal ordination 1906 as Sri Yukteswar Giri; 1894 Kumbha Mela; sent Yogananda West 1920; trained ~10 years; 'gyanavatar'; house inherited -> https://www.ananda.org/about-ananda-sangha/lineage/swami-sri-yukteswar/
Mahasamadhi March 9 1936 during Yogananda's visit after fifteen years in America -> https://yssofindia.org/about/swami-sri-yukteswar

Quote 'After my wife died, I joined the Swami Order'; 'hypercritical of his disciples'; 'Someday you will go to the West'; birth footnote 10 May 1855; second hermitage near Bay of Bengal -> https://hinduwebsite.com/sacredscripts/spiritualism/yogananda/yogananda_12.asp

Kumbha Mela January 1894 Allahabad; quote 'a short book on the underlying basic unity between the Christian and Hindu scriptures'; title swami -> https://hinduwebsite.com/sacredscripts/spiritualism/yogananda/yogananda_36.asp

Yuga arcs 12,000 years; Kali ~500-1700; Dwapara 2,400 years from ~1700; Treta 4100; armlet; stars have no conscious benevolence or animosity -> https://hinduwebsite.com/sacredscripts/spiritualism/yogananda/yogananda_16.asp
Giri branch; Yogananda initiated July 1914 and took name Yogananda -> https://anandaindia.org/autobiography-of-a-yogi/i-become-a-monk-of-the-swami-order/

Holy Science four sections (Gospel, Goal, Procedure, Revelation); quote 'takes some star for its dual and revolves round it in about 24,000 years'; Dwapara from 1699; Treta c. 4099; Binary Research Institute; most pundits hold present age is Kali; 'one Goal admitted by all scriptures' -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Holy_Science
Traditional Kali Yuga 432,000 years from 3102 BCE -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kali_Yuga
Precession caused by Sun and Moon on equatorial bulge, ~25,771 years -> https://explainingscience.org/changing-pole-star-additional-detail/
Lahiri Mahasaya 1828-1895; Yukteswar listed as disciple -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lahiri_Mahasaya
kuvalayananda: Born 30 Aug 1883 Dabhoi; birth name; died 18 April 1966 Lonavala; matric 1903; Baroda graduate 1910; Manikrao 1907-10; Madhavdas 1919; 1920-21 Baroda State Hospital; 1924 Kaivalyadhama and Yoga Mimamsa; Asanas, Pranayama 1931; Bombay 1932 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swami_Kuvalayananda

Birth/death dates; Manikrao; Madhavdas 1919 (dates 1798-1921); Tilak and Aurobindo; principal 1916; Kaivalyadhama 1924; strict rationalist; Yoga Mimamsa 1924; 'born at Dabhoi'; Amalner 1917; 'oldest and first scientific Yoga journal' -> https://kdham.com/?p=34 and https://kdham.com/the-legacy/

Parents Ganesh Laxman Gune and Saraswati; orphaned ~14; Nutan Marathi Vidyalaya; BA 1910; Madhavdas end of 1918; 1920-23 research; National College derecognised 1920; Gandhi correspondence; Vijayadashami 1924; Bombay 1932 -> https://esamskriti.com/e/Yoga/Asanas-ad-Pranayama/Swami-Kuvalayananda-~-A-Brief-Biography-1.aspx
Founded 1924 Lonavla; Yoga Mimamsa 1924; SRD; Seksaria College 1951; 'first/oldest' claims; 16 centres -> https://kdham.com/about-kaivalyadhama/ and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaivalyadhama

Bhugarbha pit study 12-14 vs up to 18 hours; no true bhugarbha samadhi; CO2 limit; Madhavdas vacuum; quote 'I have brought up this institution out of nothing' -> https://kdham.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Scientific-Research-Brochure.pdf
Madhavdas dates 1798-1921 flagged citation needed; Madhavdas Vacuum named by Kuvalayananda -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramahamsa_Madhavdas
Yoga Mimamsa vol. 1 Oct 1924 on uddiyana; X-rays cloudy; pressure fell; vacuum named for Madhavdas -> https://www.ghoshyoga.org/blogs/the-science-of-uddiyana-1924
First published study was X-ray of nauli; 1930s research on BP, asana, intragastric pressure, alveolar air; limitations discussed -> https://qigonginstitute.org/abstract-print/19786
Alter calls him one of the chief architects of the Yoga Renaissance -> https://press.princeton.edu/node/23330
Review quote 'scientific nationalism transmuted into a universalist philosophy of science'; Nehru admired -> https://www.academia.edu/3839467 (Sarbacker, History of Religions, 2007)
2019 stamp among 12 AYUSH figures (preview dated 30 Aug 2019) -> https://etvbharat.com/english/state/delhi/pm-to-release-special-stamps-on-12-unsung-rockstars-of-ayush/na20190830095450404
iyengar: Birth 14 Dec 1918 Bellur; illnesses; father's death before age nine; Mysore 1934; Pune 1937; married Ramamani 1943 (d. 1973 aged 46); Menuhin 1952 and Switzerland 1954; Light on Yoga 1966; institute 1975; Padma Shri 1991, Bhushan 2002, Vibhushan 2014; Time 100 2004; died 20 Aug 2014; NYT date 20/21; props; Pattabhi Jois claim -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B._K._S._Iyengar

11th of 13 children; mother's influenza; typhus; went to Krishnamacharya at 14; 'major turning point in my life'; 'Perfection in asana'; married 1943; Prasad 1950; Menuhin 1952; Switzerland 1954; US 1956; foundation stone Jan 1973 and Ramamani's death days later; institute 1975; Light on Pranayama 1981; Light on Life 2005; five daughters and a son; Geeta and Prashant teachers -> https://artsandculture.google.com/story/iyengar-a-yogi-s-life/bQXBKGRRbVhaJg
14 books; Time 100 2004; died Pune 20 Aug 2014 aged 95 -> https://www.funeralwise.com/digital-dying/yoga-guru-b-k-s-iyengar-dies-95

Pune 1937-40; hotel at Raasta Peth; Dr Gokhale; ten students; forty-minute demonstration 1937 -> https://scroll.in/article/841080/decades-before-there-was-a-world-yoga-day-this-is-how-bks-iyengar-won-india-over-with-his-yoga
Light on Yoga: George Allen and Unwin 1966, Menuhin foreword, ~200 postures, ~600 photographs, Patanjali prayer, hatha as one limb -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Light_on_Yoga

Four elements (alignment, sequencing, timing, props); props pioneered in Iyengar Yoga (Mehta 1990); Newcombe: no particular beliefs; Jain on unsupported medical claims; Patanjali invocation; Goldberg New Yorker 23 Aug 2014; Manos 2019 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iyengar_Yoga and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoga_using_props

NPR 2005: 'While this is a legitimate place to begin, it is not the end'; external, internal, innermost quests -> https://www.hawaiipublicradio.org/2005-11-09/light-on-life-b-k-s-iyengars-yoga-insights
2018 documentary, dir. Jake Clennell, Kino Lorber -> https://videolibrarian.com/reviews/documentary/iyengar-the-man-yoga-and-the-students-journey/
Samadhi (1977, FTII) and other RIMYI videos -> https://bksiyengar.com/modules/Referen/Video/video.htm
vethathiri: Born 14 Aug 1911 Guduvancheri; parents; weavers; school 1916; Balakrishna at 12; Paranjyothi; Ramalinga Swamigal; WCSC 1958; Aliyar 1984; ECOSOC claim; 75 books; Arivoli; died 28 March 2006 (Coimbatore per infobox); stamp 2010 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vethathiri_Maharishi (weak citations noted)

Stamp 14 Aug 2010; apprentice weaver, ~1,000 looms; Siddha/Ayurveda/homeopathy; 1,500 centres; UN invitation 9 Jan 1975; 70 books; died 28 March 2006 Coimbatore 'aged 95' -> https://www.istampgallery.com/?p=2690 and https://indianphilatelics.com/stamps/commemorative-stamps/2010/item/14786-vethathiri-commemoration-click-for-stamp-information.html (proponent-supplied text)
SKY components, ten stages, six faults, five duties, Siddha origin claim, WCSC 1958 -> https://ngmc.org/cdn/uploads/iqac/C3/3_4_3/5_-SKY-YOGA.pdf (Perumal and Jagadambal, Kanpur Philosophers 2022)
Karma as magnetic pressure; quote 'Each person is the sculptor of their life; their thoughts are the chisel' -> https://www.shanlaxjournals.in/journals/index.php/tamil/article/view/5676

WCSC 1958; 'world peace through individual peace'; yoga college 2017 affiliated to TN Physical Education and Sports University -> https://www.dinamalar.com/news/kalvimalar-katturaikal-en/yoga-courses-at-vethathiri-maharishi-yoga-college/2040
Kayakalpa claims on a course provider's page without cited studies -> https://eversafe.edu.sg/?p=22223
